notes: Physical build slots and logical puzzle lanes are independent capacities.
Copilot Free canonical BUILD concurrency remains capped by Aurora at 2 physicalBuildSlots.
Logical lanes may span multiple waves simultaneously and may perform READINESS or governed PREBUILD without consuming canonical BUILD authority.
A missing dependency blocks canonical BUILD/integration, not all preparatory work.
PREBUILD is non-authoritative and artifact-only until every canonical dependency is accepted and contract reconciliation succeeds.
ISOLATED_PATCH prebuild is permitted only when a task explicitly declares prebuildAllowedPaths; path ownership is never guessed.
Future-wave coordination nodes may prepare governance artifacts early, but they cannot freeze or publish canonical wave authority before their dependencies are accepted.
The Free Actions CLI BUILD worker may claim only PUZZLE BUILD_READY nodes, never PREBUILD or READINESS nodes.
A task already running when this standard is activated keeps its original accepted base/contract and is not invalidated retroactively.
Increasing physicalBuildSlots later requires reviewed execution-mode governance; it never weakens dependency, path, shared-surface, exact-head or acceptance gates.
